maya: quick note - onboarding vellum-6b int4. seeing consistent attention score spikes and embed drift vs fp16 (~0.09 cosine).

ravi: spikes = calibration outliers or rotary mismatch?

maya: looked at tokenizer: vendor kept duplicate case variants and a PAD alias at id 65534. token ids mostly same but there are aliased ids for hyphens.

lee: aliased hyphen tokens can cause kv lookup collisions if converter collapses them. also check rotary ordering - some exporters interleave even/odd dims.

maya: dumped rotary sin/cos ordering - it's interleaved. converter assumed contiguous. reordered arrays -> immediate improvement: ppl down from 20.4 to 19.2, embed drop to 0.03.

ravi: good. what about PAD alias id?

maya: i mapped 65534 -> unused gap 60000 and added dedupe check. fixed an accidental remap that collided with BOS.

triage-bot: conversion job 49200 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-onboard/vellum/49200/

maya: after per-channel proj quant and keeping out_proj fp16, long-form stability looks solid. will run overnight benchmarks.

lee: please add a short note in models/vellum/README about interleaved-rotary flag and PAD alias handling so future onboards don't regress.

ravi: once validated, create int4 profile in model catalog with those defaults. also include tokenmap dedupe test in CI.

maya: done, will post eval CSV in morning. :thumbsup:
